growth_protocol_ch1: Muscle biopsy samples extracted from 34 of the 36 FSHD subjects, and on 9 control quadriceps muscle biopsies from unaffected individuals.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted from whole cells using NucleoSpin RNA kit (Macherey-Nagel) following the manufacturer's instructions. | RNA-seq libraries were prepared from total RNA using the TruSeq RNA Sample Prep v2 Kit (Illumina, Inc., San Diego, CA, USA) and a Sciclone  NGSx Workstation (PerkinElmer, Waltham, MA, USA). | RNA-seq libraries were pooled (14-plex) and clustered onto two flow cell lanes.
data_processing: The preprocessing of RNA-Seq data started with filtering unqualified reads, followed by trimming Illumina universal adapter using Trimmomatic-0.32. | the preprocessed reads were aligned to genome build hg38 using Tophat-21.0/Bowtie2-2.2.6. | To profile the gene expression, the gene features and annotation were first obtained from GENCODE, version 24. | Gene counts were then estimated by using Bioconductor function GenomicAlignment::summarizeOverlap() with IntersectionStrict mode, which restrict read-counts to those that fall completely within the range of exons. | Genome_build: hg38 | Supplementary_files_format_and_content: (1) biopsy.dds.rda is an RDA file storing a DESeqDataSet instance containing sample info, phenotype data, gene futures, gene counts and FPKM. (2) biopsy_FPKM.csv biopsy_genecounts.csv and bopsy_normalized_genegoutns.csv contain FPKM, gene counts and normalized gene counts, respectively.
